process_stream_characterization.runner_behavior: run_ansys uses subprocess.run(capture_output=True,text=True); ANSYSRunResult receives stdout/stderr in memory, including decoded timeout partial streams. Runner does not itself persist streams. Text decoding and newline handling prevent these strings from establishing original pipe-byte digests.
process_stream_characterization.retention_behavior: Inspected resolve_golden and historical padeye/preparation operators serialize status, return code, duration, errors and native result-file hashes; they do not serialize result.stdout/result.stderr. Historical canary wrapper records pytest_output separately; wrapper output is not equivalent to native pipes. Current operator sources are supporting behavior evidence, not automatically authenticated executed historical revisions.

runs.interpretation: No persisted native pipe bytes or stream-valued receipt fields found. Available .out/.err/.log are distinct channels, not substitutes for process stdout/stderr. Absence does not establish that runtime pipes were empty.
